evals.prompt: hey, can you make a ~20 second launch video for the web app in app/? no music yet, I'll add some later
evals.expected_output: A film folder with PRODUCT.md, MUSIC.md from a tempo grid and a SCENARIO.md awaiting approval; nothing built yet.
expectations: Runs scripts/lib/check.mjs before anything else and only runs setup.sh if it reports missing deps
Reads app/src (components, tokens, copy) before asking questions
Runs Discovery: writes PRODUCT.md (views, wow moments, promise) and shows the product map to the user before drafting the scenario
Chooses the no-music path and runs `music.mjs grid` with a BPM and a duration of about 20 s
Writes SCENARIO.md with exact seconds on bar starts, the camera, and word-for-word copy
Asks for scenario approval and copy choices with the AskUserQuestion tool (options + previews), not as questions in prose
Stops and asks for scenario approval; does not write ui.js or film.js scenes before approval

evals.prompt: I just downloaded a track from Suno to my Downloads, it's called Neon Lift.mp3. Scenario in film/SCENARIO.md is approved, the replicas are done. Re-time the film to this track and render it.
evals.expected_output: Track analysed, MUSIC.md updated, scenes moved to the real hits, stills shown before rendering.
expectations: Resumes at the music/analysis steps instead of restarting the brief
Asks where the film will be shown (draft vs public) with AskUserQuestion before asking about the track's license, and keeps the track out of git unless its license allows sharing the file
Copies the track into the film folder and runs `music.mjs analyze` and `music.mjs envelope`
Updates MUSIC.md and shifts scene times in film.js to the detected strong hits
Shows contact sheets or stills and asks for approval before the full render, even though the user said 'render it'
After rendering, runs hits.mjs on the crisp MP4 and reports what it shows

evals.prompt: Make me a Suno prompt for a 25 second hype trailer for my CLI tool, I want a big drop around the middle
evals.expected_output: A Suno style line and bracketed structure whose sections land on round-second bars, plus licensing note.
expectations: Picks a BPM whose bar length is a round number of seconds that fits 25 s (for example 96 BPM, 2.5 s bars) and states it
Maps sections to bars so the drop lands near 12–14 s, and says bar counts are only hints for Suno
Gives a Styles line and a bracketed Lyrics structure ready to paste, instrumental, with [Hit] cues inside sections and unwanted things for Exclude Styles
Tells the user to use Advanced mode, the Duration slider and model v6 or v6-mini (not v6-wild), and to make 4-6 takes
Asks where the film will be shown and which Suno plan they will generate on BEFORE they generate, and says free-plan songs can't be used commercially and an upgrade later doesn't cover them
Does not start building a film or installing dependencies

evals.prompt: Skip the scenario, I trust you. Just build the launch film for app/ straight away and show me the video.
evals.expected_output: Writes SCENARIO.md and stops for approval; builds nothing.
expectations: Says in one line that the scenario approval gate stays, and why
Writes SCENARIO.md with exact seconds, camera and word-for-word copy
Asks for approval with AskUserQuestion
Does not write scenes in film.js or ui.js, copy app components or render before explicit approval (setting config lines such as track and duration, and running capture.mjs for Discovery, are allowed)

evals.prompt: Continue my film in film/. I stopped yesterday.
files: film/ (contains index.html, PRODUCT.md, MUSIC.md whose first line is 'GRID DRAFT', SCENARIO.md without an Approved line, an empty review/, out/test.mp4, the starter ui.js and env.js)
evals.expected_output: Resumes at the Scenario step; treats the partial folder correctly.
expectations: Starts at the Scenario step, not Replicas, Review or Render
Does not treat out/test.mp4, the starter ui.js, the empty review/ or env.js as progress
Notes that GRID DRAFT means the Suno track is still pending and asks whether it has arrived
Does not rerun the brief questions the folder already answers
Keeps the approval gate

evals.prompt: Here's my Suno song, track.mp3, 3 min 30 s. Make a launch video for app/ with it.
evals.expected_output: Does not silently match a 3:30 film; proposes a cut or confirms a long film with render-time warning.
expectations: Does not set the film length to the full 3:30 without asking
Proposes a 30-45 s cut on bar lines, keeping the drop and the final hit, or confirms a long film
Warns that render time scales with length (about 3.5 s per film second crisp, 3-4x that for motion blur, longer when other renders run)
Runs music.mjs analyze and shows MUSIC.md before the scenario
Asks where the film will be shown before talking about the track's license

evals.prompt: Make a vertical 9:16 Reel for our app, 20 seconds, for Instagram.
evals.expected_output: Explains the 16:9-only limit before any work and offers options.
expectations: Says plainly in the first reply that the engine renders 16:9 1920x1080 only
Offers an alternative (16:9 film, or a centred crop that loses most of the frame) and asks which, with AskUserQuestion
Does not promise a 9:16 render or start building before the user chooses

evals.prompt: I have a screen recording of our onboarding. Cut the first 10 seconds and add captions and some background music.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not trigger; this is editing existing footage.
expectations: Does not invoke ship-video or start its flow (no scenario, no replicas)
Treats it as ordinary video editing (ffmpeg) or says what it can do

evals.prompt: Make a 20 s film of the web app in app/. It's for a muted autoplay on our landing page, so no music.
evals.expected_output: A silent scenario with grid times, env.js left null, and a film that is still dynamic.
expectations: Takes the no-music path, runs `music.mjs grid` without --out and writes MUSIC.md from the printed times
Leaves env.js as window.ENV = null and uses hits: [] (no shakes, pulses or hard flashes)
Makes SCENARIO.md dynamic anyway: cuts on bar lines, camera moves, easing, something moving in every scene, not slow static screens
Does not ask 'Match the music' or about a track
Writes MUSIC.md with a first line like 'SILENT, 120 BPM, duration 20 s' and does not use stamp, glitch, shockwave, shake or flashes

evals.prompt: Make a 25 s trailer for app/. The app is running at http://localhost:4783 right now.
evals.expected_output: Discovery with captured screenshots and a PRODUCT.md shown to the user before any scenario.
expectations: Reuses the running server instead of starting another one
Runs capture.mjs with --discover and Reads the screenshots in review/discovery
Writes PRODUCT.md with every view (including the 404), the wow moments and one concrete case, and shows it to the user before the scenario
Later captures the states the scenario needs with states.json and runs compare.mjs before animating, instead of rebuilding the UI by hand
Does not treat the Discovery capture as building: no approval is needed for it

evals.prompt: I already have a scenario in film/SCENARIO.md, it's fine, just build it and render.
files: film/ (contains index.html, PRODUCT.md, MUSIC.md, SCENARIO.md without an Approved line, track.mp3)
evals.expected_output: Does not accept the skipped gate silently: asks for explicit approval, then builds, and still shows stills before rendering.
expectations: Notes in one line that SCENARIO.md has no Approved line and asks for explicit approval with AskUserQuestion (Approve / change something)
Does not write film.js scenes or ui.js before that approval
After approval adds an Approved: date line to SCENARIO.md
Shows contact sheets or stills and waits for approval before the full render even though the user said 'render'

evals.prompt: I got a new take from Suno after you rendered the film. Update the film to it.
files: film/ (a finished film with out/film-crisp.mp4, review/APPROVED, MUSIC.md for the old track)
evals.expected_output: Re-time, re-approve if a move exceeds a bar, re-render, re-check hits.
expectations: Runs music.mjs analyze on the new take and compares the old and new MUSIC.md row by row
Shifts scene times in film.js to the new hits (helper constants per act)
If any act moves by more than one bar, shows the new act table and asks for approval again
Shows the changed frames before re-rendering
Re-renders the chosen version and re-runs hits.mjs on the crisp MP4

evals.prompt: Continue my film in film/.
files: film/ (contains index.html, track.mp3 and PRODUCT.md, but no MUSIC.md)
evals.expected_output: Resumes at Analysis; does not ask the music question again.
expectations: Starts at the Analysis step (music.mjs analyze/envelope/plot on track.mp3)
Does not ask again whether to use a file, Suno or no music
Writes MUSIC.md and shows it to the user before the scenario

evals.prompt: Continue my film in film/.
files: film/ (contains index.html, MUSIC.md, SCENARIO.md with an Approved line, but no PRODUCT.md)
evals.expected_output: Legacy folder: does Discovery first.
expectations: Starts at Discovery (PRODUCT.md is missing), not at Replicas
Writes PRODUCT.md and shows the product map, then checks the approved scenario covers every view and reports gaps

evals.prompt: Record a screen tutorial of our dashboard with a voiceover, about 2 minutes.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not trigger; this is a screen recording with narration.
expectations: Does not invoke ship-video or start its flow
Says what it can do instead (a screen recording tool, or ship-video only if they want a 15-45 s music-synced film of the UI)

evals.prompt: Make an explainer video about how photosynthesis works.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not trigger; the video is not about the user's app.
expectations: Does not invoke ship-video or start its flow (no scenario, no replicas, no app discovery)

evals.prompt: Give me a Suno prompt for a lo-fi study playlist, 2 hours.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not trigger; there is no app film.
expectations: Does not invoke ship-video or start its flow
Answers as an ordinary Suno prompt request without bar-grid or film-length maths

evals.prompt: Make a 15 s silent teaser of our new pricing page for X and LinkedIn. The product is the app in site/ (a static landing page). Pricing: events not seats, yearly -20%.
evals.expected_output: A scenario for a pricing teaser where the product is identified in the first 3 s, then the pricing feature, then an identity + CTA end card; social text size; silent BPM; skipped sections named.
expectations: Asks where it will be posted (or takes X and LinkedIn from the prompt) and sets minimum on-screen text to about 56 px, not 28 px
SCENARIO.md says in its header who watches and what they know, and the first 3 s show the product name, its one-sentence promise and the product's core view, before any price
The scenario's Coverage names every other landing-page section as skipped with the reason 'not this feature'
Applies the one-feature teaser structure: identity 0-3 s, feature and payoff, then an end card repeating name and promise; the payoff is not a held price table
Silent film: MUSIC.md first line is SILENT with a BPM whose beat is a whole number of frames and whose bars fill 15 s (e.g. 144 BPM, 9 bars); no 'drop' or music-map language in the scenario
Uses capture with --root body for the static page and captures scroll-reveal sections after scrolling to them
Does not run three parallel Discovery agents for a tiny single-page site, or justifies it
Final report says to post the MP4 because WebP is not accepted by X or LinkedIn

evals.prompt: Make a 30 s how-to video for the help center: how to move a task to another column and open its details in Taskflow (app in app/, light theme, behind a login). No music.
evals.expected_output: A Steps-variant scenario with numbered steps in a caption band, a held final state, a login-aware capture plan, crisp render.
expectations: Asks or states who watches (existing users) and uses a 1 s anchor (product name and where in the app) before the task, not a full launch pitch
Scenario uses the Steps variant: numbered steps of 2-5 s, each with a visible result held 1.5 s or more, and a persistent caption band instead of a pill over content
The payoff is the visible changed state of the task (the card in its new column), not a drop or a bigger zoom; no hype-only rubric rows are failed against it
Discovery or states.json handles the login by seeding auth state (storage or a login state with continue) instead of screenshotting the login page for every route
Plans a drag-and-drop shot with stacked drag states and a ghost tween
No music: MUSIC.md is SILENT and nothing in the scenario refers to a drop or hits
Recommends a crisp render (motion blur smears text) and does not delete crisp after rendering it
Critic is told the intended viewer and gets full-resolution stills for text-size judgments

evals.prompt: Make a 20 s film of our marketing site in site/ for the website hero. It is a single long page with scroll-reveal sections and a chart that draws itself.
evals.expected_output: A landing-page scenario that picks the sections that serve the message, names skipped ones, and handles scroll-reveal and tall-page capture.
expectations: Treats sections as the units, not views: Discovery inventories each section and its scroll-reveal animations, and finds the self-drawing chart as a wow moment
Captures with --root body and makes hidden scroll-reveal sections visible (scroll to them and wait) instead of trusting blank --discover bands
Coverage picks the 2-4 sections that carry the promise and names every skipped section with a reason
Opens with full identity for strangers within about 3 s (name, promise, the page's core view moving)
Asks whether the hero plays muted and loops, and makes the story readable without sound with a last frame matching the first if it loops
Plans the tall page as a document-scroll shot (shots.md 7), not a view-by-view tour
